evidence.title: explainshell.com - match command-line arguments to their help text
GitHub - idank/explainshell: match command-line arguments to their help text

name: explainshell.com
summary: Web tool that matches each argument of a shell command to the relevant manpage help text.
description: Write a command line on explainshell.com and it parses the command's AST, then explains each argument with the corresponding snippet from the manpage, scoped to distributions like Ubuntu 26.04 or Arch. Open source (GPLv3), built with Python, Flask, bashlex and SQLite; manpages come from the Ubuntu archive and manned.org.
contains: matches each command-line argument to manpage help text
manpage database scoped by distro/release (Ubuntu 26.04, Arch)
